title: Support-controlled stationary comparisons on augmented CE totals
statement: For each scheme X [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and bounded-below complex K of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], simultaneously choose termwise hypercohomology presentations D(X,K) [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation], spectral-sequence maps M for every inverse-image complex map v:f^{-1}K -> L [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and stationary isomorphisms eInf:E_r(q,n-q) -> gr^q D(X,K).H_n whenever r>=1 and there exists a lower support bound a for K with max(1,q-a+2,n-q+2)<=r. The first-page map is cohomology pullback followed by Sheaf.H.map(v.f q) [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. For each f,v there exists a map u:f^{-1}D(X,K).sheafTotal -> D(Y,L).sheafTotal [lem-weil-pbc-ce-total-sections-comparison] satisfying the strict augmentation square f^{-1}(aug_X) followed by u equals v followed by aug_Y. For every n the homology map of the sections-total map totalSectionsIso_X.hom followed by ceSectionsLift(f,u) followed by totalSectionsIso_Y.inv, conjugated by c_X and c_Y, restricts to maps t_q between the abutment filtration steps. Their inclusion equation is ht. For every proof hc of compatibility with the successive step inclusions, on every page simultaneously support-admissible for K and L, the M-page map under eInf is the map cokernel.map(t_(q+1),t_q,hc). These are joint existential choices from one filtered construction, not arbitrary presentations, page maps or stationary isomorphisms. No comparison with supplied K-injective resolution lifts is asserted.

proof.text: Choose coherent supported first-page lifts D,M,e and their support filtration equalities.
Obtain stationary comparisons for arbitrary filtered total maps at the specified outer-step equalities.

Given a lower support bound a and r>=max(1,q-a+2,n-q+2), integer arithmetic gives n+2<=q+r and q-r+1<=a. Antitonicity of degreewise filtration steps transports bottom at n+2 and top at a to the required two outer equalities. Compose the stationary comparisons with this implication; it uses the existential bound only as a proposition.

For every inverse-image map choose its coherent augmented total lift. Apply stationary naturality to its sections-total map, with its filtration preservation and representative equation. Retain t and ht, and specialize the page equation to the outer equalities supplied by the source and target support conditions.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etaleHypercohomology_supported_ce_filtered_totals :
    ∃ (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})),
        EtaleTermwiseHypercohomology X K)
      (M : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (L : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (v : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K.obj ⟶ L.obj),
        (D X K).sequence ⟶ (D Y L).sequence)
      (eInf : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (q n r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hR : ∃ a : ℤ, (∀ s : ℤ, s < a → IsZero (K.obj.X s)) ∧
          max 1 (max (q - a + 2) (n - q + 2)) ≤ r),
        ((D X K).sequence.page r hr).X (q, n - q) ≅ ((D X K).H n).gradedPiece q),
      (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (L : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (v : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K.obj ⟶ L.obj) (p : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
        ((M f K L v).hom 1).f (q, (p : ℤ)) ≫ ((D Y L).firstPageIso p q).hom =
          ((D X K).firstPageIso p q).hom ≫
            AddCommGrpCat.ofHom ((Sheaf.H.map (v.f q) p).comp
              (cohomologyMap f (K.obj.X q) p))) ∧
      (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (L : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (v : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K.obj ⟶ L.obj),
        ∃ u : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (D X K).sheafTotal ⟶ (D Y L).sheafTotal,
          ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (D X K).aug ≫ u = v ≫ (D Y L).aug ∧
          ∀ n : ℤ,
            ∃ (t : ∀ q : ℤ, (((D X K).H n).step q : AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ⟶
            (((D Y L).H n).step q : AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
          (ht : ∀ q : ℤ, t q ≫ (((D Y L).H n).step q).arrow =
            (((D X K).H n).step q).arrow ≫
              (((D X K).c n).inv ≫
                HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
                  ((D X K).totalSectionsIso.hom ≫ ceSectionsLift f u ≫
                    (D Y L).totalSectionsIso.inv) n ≫ ((D Y L).c n).hom)),
          ∀ (hc : ∀ q : ℤ,
            Subobject.ofLE (((D X K).H n).step (q + 1)) (((D X K).H n).step q)
                (((D X K).H n).antitone_step (Int.le_add_one (le_refl q))) ≫ t q =
              t (q + 1) ≫
                Subobject.ofLE (((D Y L).H n).step (q + 1)) (((D Y L).H n).step q)
                  (((D Y L).H n).antitone_step (Int.le_add_one (le_refl q)))),
          ∀ (q r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hX : ∃ a : ℤ, (∀ s : ℤ, s < a → IsZero (K.obj.X s)) ∧
          max 1 (max (q - a + 2) (n - q + 2)) ≤ r)
          (hY : ∃ a : ℤ, (∀ s : ℤ, s < a → IsZero (L.obj.X s)) ∧
          max 1 (max (q - a + 2) (n - q + 2)) ≤ r),
            ((M f K L v).hom r hr).f (q, n - q) ≫ (eInf Y L q n r hr hY).hom =
              (eInf X K q n r hr hX).hom ≫
                cokernel.map
                  (Subobject.ofLE (((D X K).H n).step (q + 1)) (((D X K).H n).step q)
                    (((D X K).H n).antitone_step (Int.le_add_one (le_refl q))))
                  (Subobject.ofLE (((D Y L).H n).step (q + 1)) (((D Y L).H n).step q)
                    (((D Y L).H n).antitone_step (Int.le_add_one (le_refl q))))
                  (t (q + 1)) (t q) (hc q))
